lines.zh: 发出低沉的咆哮声，步履沉重地前行。
lines.en: Growls lowly, taking heavy steps forward.

lines.zh: 挥舞镰刀向前行进，发出沉闷的声响。
lines.en: Swings scythe, making dull noises while advancing.

lines.zh: 低头盯着前方，镰刀在手中挥动。
挥舞镰刀，发出低沉的吼声，继续前进。
lines.en: Swings scythe, growls lowly, continues forward.

lines.zh: 观察四周，目光锐利，镰刀微动。
lines.en: Scans surroundings, eyes sharp, scythe moving slightly.

lines.zh: 缓慢地挥动镰刀，步伐沉重。
目光锁定目标，镰刀紧握。
lines.en: Locks eyes on target, scythe gripped.

lines.zh: 步伐间散发出不祥的气息，镰刀在手中挥动。
目光锐利，镰刀轻挥，仿佛预感到了危险。
lines.en: Sharp eyes, scythe sweeps lightly, sensing danger.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的声音，镰刀在手中挥动，仿佛在寻找猎物。
lines.en: Low growl, scythe swings, searching for prey.
On the stone steps, the scythe tip scrapes.
Its plates clink as it moves.

lines.zh: 它沿走廊巡逻，一步不乱
lines.en: It patrols the hall, never breaking step.
Jackal head low, sniffing the seams.

lines.zh: 慵懒地站立，镰刀放在身边。
低头观察地面，镰刀轻触地面。
环顾四周，镰刀在手中转动。
lines.en: Scans surroundings, scythe turns in hand.

lines.zh: 缓慢地走动，镰刀轻轻移动。
懒洋洋地坐着，镰刀放在一旁。
凝视着远方，镰刀轻轻触碰地面。
lines.en: Stares into distance, scythe touches ground.
Low head, scythe turns in hand.

lines.zh: 缓缓地走动，镰刀轻轻摆动。
低头，镰刀轻触地面，好像在寻找什么。
lines.en: Low head, scythe touches ground, searching.

lines.zh: 发现玩家后，低吼一声，准备攻击。
lines.en: Growsl, prepares to attack upon seeing player.

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，镰刀在手中挥动。
lines.en: Locks eyes on player, scythe swings.

lines.zh: 眼窝里的光，跟着你移动。
lines.en: The light in my eye sockets tracks you.

lines.zh: 发现玩家，低沉地发出警告声。
lines.en: Low warning sound upon spotting player.

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，发出低沉的警告声。
lines.en: Locks eyes on player, growls lowly.

lines.zh: 发现玩家，镰刀在手中挥动。
盯紧玩家，镰刀挥动得更快。
lines.en: Stare at player, scythe swings faster.

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，发出警告声。
lines.en: Locks eyes on player, growls warning.
I raise my scythe, edge toward you.
You've pierced me with an arrow...

lines.zh: 阿努的镰刀不认得食物。
我的盔甲是死神的礼物！
lines.en: My armor is a gift from the dead!

lines.zh: 碰了阿努的雕像，我的镰刀就醒了。
lines.en: You touched Anu's statue, and my scythe woke.

lines.zh: 镰刀扫过去，别站在弧线里。
lines.en: The scythe sweeps; stay out of its arc.

lines.zh: 镰刀柄撞到你，是我先动手。
lines.en: My scythe haft struck you - I struck first.
My scythe is ready for you!

lines.zh: 离雕像五步，你就该停下。
lines.en: Five steps from the statue is where you stop.
I need to fight to reproduce!

lines.zh: 你的声音激起了我的战斗欲望！
lines.en: Your voice stirs my combat desire!

lines.zh: 用你的身体激发我的力量！
lines.en: Use your body to fuel my strength!

lines.zh: 刀锋相碰，才算打过招呼。
lines.en: Blades touching is how we greet.

lines.zh: 战斗才能证明我的价值！
阿努的命令就是我的命令！
发出嘶嘶声，锋利的爪子紧握。
低语咒文，魔法准备释放。
lines.en: Whispers incantations, magic at the ready.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咆哮，准备冲锋。
嘶嘶声中，尖牙利爪显露。
lines.en: Hisses, sharp teeth and claws exposed.
Locks onto prey, stares for a moment.

lines.zh: 观察片刻，确定攻击机会。
瞄准猎物，准备一击必杀。
锁定敌方，准备致命一击。

lines.en: You have stepped into Anu's castle.
Five blocks away, the statue remembers you.
The piglin sentries hold the other side.

lines.zh: 瞄准猎物，迅速挥动镰刀。
镰刀从雕像的影子里抬起。
lines.en: My scythe lifts from the statue's shadow.
The scythe levels and seals your retreat.

lines.zh: 它侧身，为下一刀留角度
lines.en: It turns sideways to angle the next cut.
The haft spins; the back of the blade lands first.
Not fast, but every cut is measured.
Will you be cut in two?
A sweeping cut throws up stone chips.
It drops nothing but the flash of the blade.
The edge runs from your shoulder to your waist.
The blow misses; it has already turned.
Anubis' statue, splits to birth me!
Anubis' command, I rise from stone!

lines.zh: 阿努的守护者，从石中现！
阿努的命令，我从石中出！
lines.en: Anubis' command, I emerge from stone!
The statue bursts; I step out of it.
You came within five blocks of the statue.

lines.zh: 阿努的城堡，多一名守卫
石壳剥落，镰刀先露出来
lines.en: The stone shell falls away; the scythe shows first.

lines.zh: 魔法能量灼烧我的皮肤...
镰刀导电，我被劈得发抖。
lines.en: My scythe carried the bolt. I'm shaking.
The statue shattered, and I scatter with it.
